name: DarkMeta Dark Mode
author: devtheme

sections.description:
DarkMeta Dark Mode WP Plugin is a lightweight plugin that allows you to add dark mode functionality to your WordPress website. Users can toggle between light and dark themes using a simple button, and their preferences are saved for future visits.

Features:
– Dark mode toggle button.
– Icon-based toggle for user-friendly design.
– Persistent dark mode settings using localStorage.
– Customizable styles through included CSS files.
– Fully compatible with WordPress admin dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wp-dark-mode directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. The dark mode toggle button will appear on the frontend and admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any theme?

Yes, DarkMeta Dark Mode WP Plugin is designed to be compatible with any WordPress theme.

Can I customize the styles?

Yes, you can edit the style.css file in the plugin’s assets folder to customize the dark mode appearance.

Does this plugin save user preferences?

Yes, the plugin uses localStorage to save user preferences across page reloads.
